headline: Last session: Sensex gains 308 points, Nifty reclaims 23,000 driven by IT and pharma rally.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: IT and pharma stocks rallied during the last trading session, supporting index gains.
IndiGo jumped 4% and HCLTech gained 2% in Friday's session.
Over the weekly wrap, Sensex and Nifty50 gained 2% while Nifty Smallcap 100 jumped 4%.
Broader market weakness and underperformance in mid and smallcaps limited overall market upside.
whatHappening: Sensex ended the last trading day 308 points higher while Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 mark.
Trent led the weekly market rally alongside gains across smallcap indices.
In the previous session on Thursday, Sensex surged 905 points led by Adani Enterprises and Kotak Bank.
CCI cleared French billionaire Xavier Niel's proposal to acquire over 16% stake in Vodafone Group.
summary:
In the last trading session on Friday, 30 October 2026, Sensex gained 308 points to close higher while Nifty reclaimed 23,000.
Major stock movers included IndiGo, HCLTech, Adani Enterprises, and Trent as IT and pharma sectors led the market higher.
The NSE market is closed today, Saturday 31 October 2026, for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 2 November 2026.
